jobs.title: Art Director
jobs.description: We’re looking for an Art Director with a sharp visual eye and strong production design experience to lead the look and feel of our campaigns. This is an onsite position at Armal Compound 2, M. Eusebio Avenue, San Miguel, Pasig City. You will report directly to the President. You’ll be responsible for shaping visual direction from concept through execution, ensuring every asset aligns with the brand and campaign strategy. Key Responsibilities Own the visual direction of campaigns across photo, video, digital and social media content. Lead production design for campaign shoots, including sets, props, styling, environments, and overall visual world. Develop and refine mood boards, visual references, and style frames to communicate creative vision. Collaborate closely with Creative Director, Brand and other departments to bring campaign concepts to life. Art direct photoshoots and video shoots on set, ensuring visual consistency and high-quality execution. Review and provide feedback on photography, video edits, motion, and retouching to ensure visuals meet creative standards. Ensure all campaign visuals align with brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries when appropriate. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and visual excellence. Partner with external vendors, photographers, stylists, set designers, and production teams as needed.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
jobs.description: Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness. As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers. Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production. This role is for you if… you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk. This role isn't for you if… your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start. Key Responsibilities Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach. Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces. Route harnesses through rotating joints and moving axes: select flex- and torsion-rated cables and drive cable life tests together with mechanical engineering. Work closely with our electronics team on interfaces, connectors, power distribution boards and safety circuits. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.
